title: The 6 Best Patio Heaters for Small Patios
h1: The 6 Best Patio Heaters for Small Patios
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for patio heaters for small patios, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at patio heaters for small patios using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Fire Sense 60262 Tabletop Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 10,000 BTU propane burner, Stainless steel tabletop design, Auto-shutoff tilt valve.
strengths: Small enough for a two-top bistro table without dominating the space
Auto-shutoff tilt valve is a real safety feature on a table shared with drinks and elbows
10,000 BTU is genuinely enough for the people sitting closest to it
limitations: Heat drops off sharply past 3 to 4 feet
Runs on small 1lb cylinders that need more frequent swapping than a 20lb tank
Not rated for covered spaces with low ceilings, since it still vents an open flame
features: Runs on a standard 1lb propane cylinder

products.name: Mr. Heater 11,000 BTU Table Top Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 to 11,000 BTU adjustable output, Runs on a 1lb propane cylinder, Compact tabletop footprint.
strengths: Adjustable BTU range lets you dial down heat for warmer evenings instead of running full blast
Piezo ignition lights reliably without a separate lighter
Lighter and more compact than most tabletop competitors
limitations: Lower ceiling on max BTU than the Fire Sense at full output
1lb cylinders run out faster than most owners expect on a cool night
Fewer safety certifications listed than the Fire Sense model

products.name: Dr. Infrared Heater Carbon Infrared Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 120V / 1500W carbon infrared element, 3 heat settings (900W, 1200W, 1500W), IP55 weatherproof rating.
strengths: No propane tank, so it clears most apartment and condo restrictions
IP55 rating means it genuinely handles rain and humidity, not just light drizzle
Mounting it on a wall frees up all floor space on a tight balcony
limitations: 1500W draws a real amount from a standard outlet, so check your circuit before running other appliances on the same line
Electric heat has a smaller effective radius than an open-flame propane heater
Needs an outdoor-rated outlet within cord reach if not hardwired

products.name: Solaira Cosy Infrared Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W / 120V quartz infrared element, Covers roughly a 10 by 10 foot area, 15.5-inch slim housing.
strengths: Slim 4-inch-deep housing mounts flush against a wall or under an eave without bulk
Commercial-grade build quality shows up in the quieter operation and even heat spread
Quartz lamp warms up almost instantly, unlike heaters that need a few minutes to ramp up
limitations: Costs noticeably more than the propane options on this list
Requires a dedicated 120V circuit and professional-leaning install for permanent mounting
Overkill wattage for a two-person bistro table
features: Covers roughly a 10 by 10 foot area

products.name: AZ Patio Heaters Tall Outdoor Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 48,000 BTU propane burner, 87-inch hammered bronze standing design, 10 to 15 foot heat radius.
strengths: Warms a genuinely wide radius, more than any tabletop or wall-mount option here
Wheeled base makes it easy to push against a wall when not in use to reclaim floor space
48,000 BTU output holds up even on colder nights
limitations: Needs a solid 3 to 4 foot circle of clear floor space, which is tight on a small patio
The 87-inch height can feel oversized visually on a compact space
Uses a standard 20lb propane tank, bulkier to store than a 1lb cylinder

products.name: Hiland HLDS032-B Tabletop Patio Heater, 11,000 BTU
strengths: Warms a table area without floor space
Runs on 1 lb or 20 lb propane

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
